notes: All fixtures are project-authored synthetic diagnostics, not real customer tickets.
Expected phrases and review flags were frozen independently before inference, not supplied by human raters.
Lexical retention is not semantic correctness, actionability, or professional summary quality.
Copying a sentence prevents newly generated words, but can still omit critical context or preserve a false user statement.
Challenge results are observations only; no model, threshold, extractor, or review rules were retuned after viewing fixture scores.
